artboards.title: The way in: today vs after

annotations.text:
Start here — this artboard is live.

Walk the four steps: type an Identity API (or tap the fill chip), pick a provider preset, then Continue. On step 3 press "Find my daemon" to watch discovery settle. The rail at the top jumps straight to any step.

The complaint, and the answer.

Left is what ships today: an amber wall the reader cannot act on, above an Unlock tab. Right is after setup — the notice is gone, Unlock is withheld while there is no sealed vault to open, and the deployment it is pointed at reads along the foot.

The one open decision: how setup is navigated on a phone.

A is built. B is drawn because it is the app's existing ceremony vocabulary and deserved a fair hearing — its cost is that the finishing action moves whenever a row opens, which is exactly the mobile complaint.
